props.name: fromLabel
props.description: Name of the first value — “2025”, “Free plan”.

props.name: sort
props.description: Keep the given order, sort by the size of the gap, or by the second value. Largest first.

props.name: zeroBased
props.description: Start the value axis at zero rather than hugging the data.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in viewBox pixels.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the key under the chart.
